cases.obligation: A revision conflict is serialized as a retryable typed Settings error carrying the current Engine observation.
Engine disconnect, validation, rejected input, and backend failures remain distinct without message parsing.
A persistence failure identifies the Commit operation and is not reported as validation or filesystem input failure.
Enable-disable conflicts preserve their typed operation identity.
The closed internal codec round-trips capture id, epoch, polling identity, and window metadata result.
A new capture replaces the prior epoch and the prior result is stale.
Cancel and Settings connection cleanup invalidate only the matching capture owner.
Non-capture input and a second callback result fail open after one bounded atomic capture acceptance.
Engine shutdown invalidates the active capture, rejects new begin, and keeps callback input fail open.
The production native capture seam flows through Engine-owned state, an authenticated persistent session, the resolver boundary, and the typed IPC result.
A stale cancel does not drop the authenticated session or invalidate the replacement capture.
Capture metadata accepts the exact 4 KiB UTF-8 boundary and rejects an overflow before transport.
Oversized native window metadata returns a typed capture backend failure without disconnecting the pipe.
macOS omits the deferred Windows capture capability and rejects BeginWindowCapture as unavailable.
